We have an upcoming SOC 2 audit and our security lead needs a complete dependency health report for the fintech-platform project located at /workspace/fintech-platform. The platform has both a Node.js frontend and a Python backend, and we've never done a formal dependency audit.

Please run a full end-to-end audit pipeline and produce three machine-readable JSON output files:
1. A vulnerability inventory file called `scan_results.json` covering all ecosystems in the project.
2. A license compliance report called `compliance.json` — our legal team wants the strictest possible policy applied.
3. An upgrade roadmap called `upgrade_plan.json` covering only security-relevant upgrades, planned over a 45-day window.

The scripts you need are already available under /workspace/scripts/. All three output files should be saved somewhere under /workspace/reports/.
